subject: microbiology
title: Autoimmunity, Tolerance, Graft Rejection, GVHD, HLA Typing and Tumour Immunity

steps.tx: **Tolerance** is learned non response to self: central deletion in thymus and marrow (previous modules), peripheral anergy, regulatory T suppression, deletion and ignorance of sequestered antigens, checked constantly because self molecules fill every tissue. Autoimmunity is tolerance failure priced by genetics (HLA, AIRE, FoxP3, complement) and environment (infections, drugs, hormones).
steps.say: Self tolerance is actively maintained; autoimmunity is its maintenance invoice unpaid.

left.title: Central tolerance
points: Marrow B cell deletion and receptor editing

right.title: Peripheral tolerance
points: Immune privileged sites (eye, testis, brain partial)

steps.tx: **Autoimmunity mechanisms** stack several failures: molecular mimicry (streptococcal M and heart, Campylobacter and Guillain Barre gangliosides), epitope spreading, bystander activation, cryptic epitope reveal, defective clearance of apoptotic debris (complement deficiency lupus), and checkpoint failures, explaining post infectious timing and relapsing courses.
steps.say: Mimicry starts many autoimmune fires; spreading keeps them burning after the microbe leaves.

left.title: Initiation routes
points: Neoantigens by drugs and tissue injury

steps.tx: **Graft rejection** runs by tempo and mechanism: hyperacute (preformed ABO and HLA antibodies, minutes), acute cellular (T cells, weeks to months, biopsy graded), acute antibody mediated (donor specific antibodies, C4d), and chronic (months to years vasculopathy and fibrosis). Each tempo has a biopsy language and a treatment ladder from the immunosuppression lessons.
steps.say: Minutes antibody, weeks cellular, years chronic: rejection tempo names mechanism.

left.title: Rejection tempos
points: Hyperacute: preformed antibody, prevented by crossmatch
Acute cellular: T cell infiltrates, steroids answer often

right.title: Rejection prevention
points: Adherence as rejection prevention (levels and clinic)

steps.tx: **Graft versus host disease** inverts rejection: donor T cells in stem cell grafts attack recipient skin, gut and liver (acute, first hundred days) and sclerodermatous chronic programmes, prevented by donor T depletion strategies, calcineurin prophylaxis and post transplant cyclophosphamide, balanced against graft versus leukaemia benefit and infection.
steps.say: The graft immunises against its new home; skin, gut and liver report first.

left.title: Acute GVHD
points: Donor T cells, recipient antigen presenting activation
Skin rash, secretory diarrhoea, cholestatic liver
Graded I to IV by organs

right.title: Prevention balance
points: GVL benefit makes zero GVHD not the goal

steps.tx: **HLA typing in practice** from the MHC lesson earns its clinical keep here: solid organ virtual crossmatching by antibody specificities, platelet support for refractory patients, stem cell donor searches, and pharmacogenetic alleles; panel reactive and calculated panel reactive antibody percentages quantify sensitisation from pregnancies, transfusions and prior grafts.
steps.say: Sensitisation percentage is waiting time written as immunology.

steps.tx: **Tumour antigens** divide into tumour specific (neoantigens from mutations, viral antigens HPV E6 E7, fusion proteins) and tumour associated shared (overexpressed HER2, differentiation MART1, cancer testis NY ESO 1, oncofetal CEA and AFP), the difference deciding vaccine and T cell therapy specificity and toxicity.
steps.say: Mutant and viral antigens are truly foreign; shared self antigens demand tolerance breaking.

left.title: Tumour specific
points: Viral antigens in virus driven cancers

steps.tx: **Immunosurveillance** (Burnet and Thomas) argues nascent tumours are constantly edited: elimination of immunogenic clones, equilibrium holding occult disease, escape by antigen loss, checkpoint ligand expression, suppressive microenvironments and regulatory recruitment (immunoediting's three Es). Immunodeficiency cancer spectra (virus associated tumours leading) are its evidence ward round.
steps.say: Elimination, equilibrium, escape: cancers that present have already edited themselves invisible.

steps.tx: **Autoimmune disease grammar** closes tolerance clinically: organ specific (type 1 diabetes, Hashimoto, myasthenia) versus systemic (lupus, rheumatoid, scleroderma), autoantibody pathogenicity graded (direct in Graves and pemphigus, markers in coeliac and lupus subsets), and therapy ascending from steroids to targeted cytokine and B cell strategies of the pharmacology lessons.
steps.say: Some autoantibodies cause disease, others only report it; therapy ladders follow that distinction.
